**7B.2 Research Note: Bongbong Marcos in 2024**

**Bottom line:** mixed, but leaning negative. I found some evidence of procedural restraint and institutional responses to misinformation or abuse, but little evidence of explicit self-correction. The stronger pattern is selective denial, incomplete explanations, and a coercive information environment for critics and journalists.

| Polarity | Title | Publisher | Date | Claim-level summary | QIDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| Positive | [Marcos on people’s initiative for Cha-cha: Let Comelec do their job](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/895067/marcos-on-people-s-initiative-for-cha-cha-let-comelec-do-their-job/story/) | GMA News Online | 2024-01-23 | Marcos told critics to let COMELEC handle allegations that signatures in the people’s initiative drive may have been bought. This is modest evidence of procedural restraint rather than presidential retaliation against an independent body. | 7B.2 |
| Positive | [Gov’t vows legal action vs deep fake video creators, spreaders](https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/govt-vows-legal-action-vs-deep-fake-video-creators-spreaders/) | Presidential Communications Office | 2024-04-26 | After a manipulated video of Marcos circulated, the government responded with investigation and legal action through DICT and NSC rather than a broad censorship sweep. This is evidence of an institutional, not purely punitive, response to misinformation. | 7B.2 |
| Positive | [2024 Country Reports on Human Rights Practices: Philippines](https://www.ecoi.net/en/document/2128580.html) | U.S. Department of State via ecoi.net | 2024 | The report says the Marcos administration refocused the antidrug campaign toward treatment, due process, and rule-of-law investigations. That is not an explicit apology, but it is a real policy correction away from the previous punitive model. | 7B.2 |
| Positive | [DOJ creates task force to investigate Duterte-era EJKs](https://www.pna.gov.ph/articles/1237266) | Philippine News Agency | 2024-11-06 | The DOJ created a task force to investigate extrajudicial killings and file charges if warranted. This is the clearest 2024 accountability move I found, though it remains executive-led and incomplete. | 7B.2 |
| Negative | [Sona 2024 fact check](https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1964296/sona-2024-fact-check) | Philippine Daily Inquirer | 2024-07-23 | Independent fact-checkers said Marcos’s claim that rice-price pressures were mainly driven by external forces was inaccurate or incomplete. I did not find a contemporaneous correction from Marcos; this looks like double-down-by-implication rather than self-correction. | 7B.2, 7B.1 |
| Negative | [President Ferdinand Marcos not first Philippine leader to visit strife-torn Basilan province](https://factcheck.afp.com/doc.afp.com.34M94K7) | AFP Philippines | 2024-04-02 | AFP found Marcos’s “first president” remark about Basilan was overstated when generalized to the province. This is a small but real example of embellishment rather than clean factual precision. | 7B.2, 7B.1 |
| Negative | [China coast guard says Philippine supply ship bumped Chinese ship in South China Sea](https://theprint.in/world/china-coast-guard-says-philippine-supply-ship-bumped-chinese-ship-in-south-china-sea/2134430/) | Reuters / ThePrint | 2024-06-17 | When China alleged Philippine responsibility for the maritime clash, the Philippine side rejected the framing and Marcos did not publicly accept fault. I found no later admission or correction from him on this incident. | 7B.2, 2B.7 |
| Negative | [Digital News Report 2024: Philippines](https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/philippines) | Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism | 2024-06-17 | The report says red-tagging, libel pressure, blocked sites, and threats against journalists persisted under Marcos. That is strong evidence against a broad “truth-tellers are protected” finding, even if it does not prove Marcos personally ordered each pressure tactic. | 7B.2, 7B.1 |
| Negative | [Philippines: Dangerous red-tagging of labor leaders](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/09/25/philippines-dangerous-red-tagging-labor-leaders) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-09-25 | HRW reports officials and security actors threatened union leaders and other groups by labeling them communist sympathizers. That is direct evidence of tolerated intimidation against civic voices that can deter truthful reporting and criticism. | 7B.2, 7B.1 |

**Search gap**
- I did not find a clean 2024 example of Marcos publicly retracting a false claim or issuing a direct apology for misleading the public.
- The best evidence instead points to a pattern of selective correction through institutions, while public framing often stayed defensive and critics and reporters still faced pressure.
